Sep 22, 2026ExcusedpassedCorrigan Farms data-center agreement sent to councilThe commission recommended a development agreement for Corrigan Farms, the land just rezoned for RTI (data-center) use. The city attorney walked through its 20-year term, infrastructure duties, impact fees, road-maintenance repayment, vested rights and a clause shielding confidential business information. Commissioners noted the current draft carries no tax incentives. No one spoke at the public hearing.

The meeting it was decided at

Sep 22, 2026ExcusedpassedCorrigan Farms rezone for data centers sent to councilThe owners of Corrigan Farms, farmland that is now QTS's trailer lot, asked to add the RTI overlay zone that allows data centers and similar uses. RTI-zoned land already borders it on the north, east and south. The owners said they have no buyer yet. Commissioners said it would be hard to deny given the land around it, while noting residents' worries about long-term industrial growth. Two residents spoke and two sent emails.

The meeting it was decided at

Sep 22, 2026ExcusedpassedArchery zoning rules go to councilArchery is banned everywhere in Eagle Mountain today. At the council's request, staff drafted rules that would allow it inside the city's existing shooting overlay zone, using USA Archery safety standards. The commission recommended them to the City Council. No one spoke at the public hearing.

The meeting it was decided at

Sep 22, 2026ExcusedpassedWildfire-zone landscaping rules go to councilThe commission recommended new standards for the wildland urban interface, where homes meet open brush land. They cover landscaping and clearing vegetation, and they respond to a 2026 state law (HB 215) and setback advice from fire officials. Staff will tidy some technical wording first. No one spoke at the public hearing.
